guard: a failed membership read is never served or drawn as a successful empty one, on the server and in the client's pill, boot read, feed and ordering rule
why: This suite runs `tsx` directly over `src` and `client/src`, with no build step and no compiled second copy, so no `afterRestore` is needed on any mutation here.

mutations.name: the watch's closed callback stops broadcasting the refusal
mutations.expectRed: a closed watch reaches the browser as the membership-read-failed frame, byte for byte
mutations.cell: a closed watch reaches the browser as the membership-read-failed frame, byte for byte

mutations.name: MR1 the pill checks `available` before `unreadable`, so a failed read, which arrives with no members, is called traffic-only: a claim about the mesh standing in for a fact about us
MR2 the pill stops saying unreadable once a snapshot exists, so a feed that failed after a good read is drawn as live or stale
mutations.expectRed: an unreadable feed with a fresh snapshot still reads unreadable, not live
mutations.cell: an unreadable feed with a fresh snapshot still reads unreadable, not live

mutations.name: MR3 the membership read stops going through the status gate, so a 503 refusal parses as a snapshot and the pill reads traffic-only
mutations.expectRed: M4: a 503 refusal reaching the boot path renders 'unreadable', not 'traffic-only'
mutations.cell: M4: a 503 refusal reaching the boot path renders 'unreadable', not 'traffic-only'

mutations.name: MR4 a refused bootstrap membership read stops setting `unreadable`, so the refusal is stored nowhere and the pill reads traffic-only
mutations.expectRed: M4: a 503 refusal reaching the boot path renders 'unreadable', not 'traffic-only'
mutations.cell: M4: a 503 refusal reaching the boot path renders 'unreadable', not 'traffic-only'

mutations.name: MR5 a membership read that gets no answer at all is turned into an empty snapshot again, the old `.catch(() => ({members: []}))` that manufactured traffic-only out of a dead socket
mutations.replace: membership: () => get<MembershipSnapshot>("/api/membership", "membership").catch((e: Error) => { if (/refused with HTTP/.test(e.message)) throw e; return { members: [] }; }),
mutations.expectRed: M7: a REJECTED boot fetch renders 'unreadable', not 'traffic-only'
mutations.cell: M7: a REJECTED boot fetch renders 'unreadable', not 'traffic-only' (no answer is not an empty answer)

mutations.name: MR6 the feed listens on a different name than the server emits for a membership refusal, so the browser never hears it and the pill stays silent
mutations.expectRed: the feed registers a listener for the refusal event
mutations.cell: the feed registers a listener for the refusal event

mutations.name: MR7 the feed drops the refusal's reason on the way to the handler, so the operator is told THAT membership failed and never WHY
mutations.expectRed: and the event's `reason` is what reaches the handler, so the operator sees WHY
mutations.cell: and the event's `reason` is what reaches the handler, so the operator sees WHY

mutations.name: MR8 the feed is authoritative while unreadable, so the page keeps asserting a hub is empty from a snapshot it has just disowned
mutations.expectRed: AN UNREADABLE FEED IS NOT AUTHORITATIVE
mutations.cell: AN UNREADABLE FEED IS NOT AUTHORITATIVE: nothing is asserted empty while the feed cannot be read

mutations.name: MR9 an unreadable feed discards its last snapshot, so the honest record of when it was last read successfully is thrown away with the failure
mutations.expectRed: an unreadable feed still records WHEN it was last read successfully
mutations.cell: an unreadable feed still records WHEN it was last read successfully (asOf is not discarded)

mutations.name: MR10 a live membership refusal stops marking its source live, so a late successful bootstrap read clears the refusal it had already reported
mutations.expectRed: a LATE bootstrap membership() resolve does not clear `unreadable`
mutations.cell: a LATE bootstrap membership() resolve does not clear `unreadable` (the feed spoke after that read was issued)
